title: Famous Sports Around the World
summary: Football is the world’s most popular sport, but basketball, tennis, baseball, cricket, and the Olympic Games are also very well known. Sports become famous when they are easy to play, exciting to watch, or important to a country.

cover.alt: A child and an adult play football on a neighborhood pitch while families watch from a bench.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: Football is the world’s most popular sport, but basketball, tennis, baseball, cricket, and the Olympic Games are also very well known. Sports become famous when they are easy to play, exciting to watch, or important to a country.

items.prompt: What sport do you like to watch?
What sports do children play near your home?

blocks.title: Part 1: What Makes a Sport Famous?
paragraphs: A **well-known** sport is a sport that many people know. A **popular** sport has many players or fans. A sport can be very famous in one place but less famous in another. Baseball is a top sport in Japan and several other countries. Football is popular across the world.
We can use three ideas: Do many people play it? Do many people watch it? Does it have a strong story or tradition?

images.alt: Children play street football in a park while adults watch from a bench, with a baseball glove in the grass.

blocks.title: Check: Part 1: What Makes a Sport Famous?

items.prompt: What three ideas can help us understand why a sport is famous?
items.answer: We can ask if many people play it, if many people watch it, and if it has a strong story or tradition.

blocks.title: Part 2: Football—the World’s Game
paragraphs: Football, also called soccer, is the world’s most popular sport. About 250 million people play it in more than 200 countries and territories. Two teams of 11 players try to kick a ball into a goal.
Football is easy to start: children often need only a ball and an open space. People can play at school, in a park, or in the street. This helps football become famous almost everywhere.

items.prompt: Why is football easy for many children to start?
items.answer: Football is easy to start because children often need only a ball and an open space.

blocks.title: Part 3: The World Cup and the Olympic Games
paragraphs: Big events help sports become more famous. The FIFA World Cup happens every four years. About 1.5 billion people watched the 2022 final in Qatar. Countries wait a long time for this special event, so it feels important.

The Olympic Games are also famous. They bring many sports and countries together. At Tokyo 2020, more than 11,300 athletes from 206 nations competed. Viewers can see running, swimming, football, and many other sports.

images.alt: Young spectators watch a football match in a large stadium with a running track around the pitch.

blocks.title: Check: Part 3: The World Cup and the Olympic Games

items.prompt: How do the World Cup and the Olympic Games make sports famous?
items.answer: They bring countries together and let very large numbers of people watch important competitions.

blocks.title: Part 4: Basketball and Tennis
paragraphs: Basketball has two teams with five players on each side. Players shoot a ball through a high hoop. The NBA is its most famous professional league, with 30 teams. School gyms and street courts also help people play the game.
Tennis can be one player against one player, or two against two. Its four Grand Slam events are very famous. Wimbledon began in London in 1877 and is the oldest tennis tournament.

items.prompt: What helps basketball and tennis stay well known?
items.answer: Basketball has the famous NBA and many school or street courts, while tennis has famous Grand Slam events such as Wimbledon.

blocks.title: Part 5: Baseball and Cricket
paragraphs: Some sports are especially famous in certain parts of the world. Baseball is a top sport in Japan and the Americas. Two teams of nine players hit, throw, and run around four bases. The World Series is the championship of Major League Baseball.

Cricket is especially famous in South Asia, Australia, and England. Two teams of 11 use a bat and ball. About 90 percent of cricket’s billion-plus fans are in South Asia. Place can make a big difference.

items.prompt: Why can baseball or cricket feel more famous in some countries?
items.answer: They can feel more famous because many local families, players, and fans follow them.

blocks.title: Part 6: Different Reasons for Fame
paragraphs: There is no single reason why a sport becomes famous. Football is simple to start and has fans around the world. The World Cup and Olympic Games bring many countries together. Basketball has famous professional teams and local courts. Tennis has old events such as Wimbledon. Baseball and cricket have strong local traditions.
A sport grows when children can play it, families watch it, and important games create exciting stories. The most famous sport can also be different in each place.

images.alt: A baseball batter, a cricket batter, and a tennis player share one sunny community sports ground.

blocks.title: Check: Part 6: Different Reasons for Fame

items.prompt: What are three reasons that sports become famous?
items.answer: Sports become famous because people can play them, many fans watch them, and important events or local traditions give them strong stories.

items.prompt: Which sport do you think will become more famous in your country, and why?
